test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.**

__Despite my make__ best efforts I could not get admission to the course of my choice.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Despite making**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses an incorrect form of the verb "**make**".
 
• We need to use a gerund form of "make" which is "**making**" in the sentence. We know that after the preposition we need to use a prepositional object that can be a noun/gerund/noun phrase. Hence, we need to use "making"
 
• Also, the possessive adjective "**my**" should be before the noun **best**.

**The correct sentence is**: *Despite making__ my best efforts I could not get admission to the course of my choice.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1**.
